The task itself is simple, but there will be challenges as the caves here are swarming with corrupted Grabber machines! I ask that you collect any Ancient Heartwood tree roots you find. 

Keep them and bring them back to me, I will eventually perform the ritual to save the Essence within. 

Willing to help?
